meta.name: assess-covariance-method
meta.description: Rigorously and honestly assess a NEW or proposed covariance / correlation / precision estimator, or a new covariance scoring rule, using precise. Use when someone proposes, asks to evaluate, or wants to compare a covariance methodology. Covers implementing it to the contract, conformance, benchmarking against the registry, out-of-sample validation, and statistically defensible inference.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 严格评估协方差估计方法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要严谨评估新的协方差或相关估计器
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to rigorously evaluate a new covariance or correlation estimator

howto.what: 装好后，Claude会严格按照协议评估你提出的新协方差、相关或精度估计方法，包括实现检查、符合性测试、基准对比、样本外验证和统计推断，并给出诚实结论。
howto.when: 当你提出或要求评估、比较一个新的协方差方法时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估一下这个新协方差估计方法。
say.note: Claude将按照步骤实施和测试该方法。

say.text: 比较我的方法和基准库里的方法。
say.note: Claude会运行基准测试并报告相对误差。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will rigorously assess a new covariance/correlation/precision estimator or scoring rule you propose, covering implementation conformance, benchmarking, out-of-sample validation, and statistically defensible inference, and deliver an honest verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you propose, ask to evaluate, or want to compare a covariance methodology.

say_en.text: Assess this new covariance estimator I designed.
say_en.note: Claude will walk through the protocol steps.

say_en.text: Compare my method against the registry benchmarks.
say_en.note: Claude will run bakeoff.py and report per-ensemble results.
